title: Design System: Todo List Blue Workspace

display.purpose: Fraunces headings for To-Do List, Tasks, Calendar, and account identity.

body.purpose: Tasks, event details, instructions, and forms.

motion.name: navigation
motion.purpose: Directional To-Do List and Calendar transitions.

motion.name: panel
motion.purpose: Compact control, stack, and form transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary task, event, save, and authentication action.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Task, event, account, and review text entry.

components.name: Task Card
components.description: Compact, flat task row with metadata and actions.

components.name: Extra Label
components.description: Optional-task metadata shown beside Overdue when both apply.

components.name: Calendar View Navigation
components.description: Day, Week, Month, and Year navigation with one active blue underline.

narrative.overview: This interface is a quiet productivity workspace: structured enough for dense schedules, calm enough to stay open all day. Cool white and navy-gray grounds create continuity between every application surface. Motion confirms context changes without delaying input.

rules.name: The Color Role Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only primary action color; purple never represents tasks, red never represents a normal action, and completed work always recedes into blue-gray.

rules.name: The Appearance Pair Rule
rules.body: Light and dark modes use the same semantic hierarchy, not independent palettes. System mode resolves live from the device setting.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Main cards, calendar cells, and task rows never rely on a large ambient shadow for structure.

dos: Do keep blue reserved for primary task and navigation actions.
Do show all seven weekdays together on desktop Week view.
Do use consistent outlined SVG iconography.
donts: Don't reintroduce orange or green as interface accents.
Don't constrain the Calendar to the To-Do List width.
Don't use gradients, thick side stripes, decorative glass, or permanent card shadows.
